spec_case: issue #778 step 7 (userinfo in a proxy URL becomes Basic proxy auth for a curl-based adapter too)
description: `http_proxy` carries synthetic `user:pass` userinfo; the mock server, acting as the proxy, must receive a `Proxy-Authorization: Basic ...` header built from it -- written into curl's own `--config` file (`curl_support.py`/`transport.rs`), never argv.
